bio: The trip out here into the countryside is definitely worth it! Clad in Swiss hardwood, the building housing this restaurant stands directly adjacent to a recreational area and close to the Reuss River. Chef Manuel Steigmeier serves up modern cuisine with sustainability at its heart and that is bold, sophisticated and stripped down to the essentials. His ingredients are of the highest quality, and he makes a point of sourcing from Switzerland or the region. A prime example is the wonderfully succulent and perfectly cooked char, with a delicately balanced and rich beurre blanc with lime, potato brunoise and caviar from Frutigen, accompanied by spicy sweet-and-sour pickled celery with a crisp texture.
